content.text:
=== bootstrap_active refs ===
server/lib/nebu/matrix/session/bootstrap_checker/postgres.ex:24:  VALUES ('bootstrap_active', 'true', $1)
server/lib/nebu/matrix/session/bootstrap_checker.ex:9:  When bootstrap triggers: inserts 'bootstrap_active' = 'true' into server_config,
=== admin router bootstrap routes ===
55:  The following LiveView has been CONVERTED to a plain HTTP controller (fix-bootstrap-wizard-liveview-bugs):
56:    - BootstrapLive   → BootstrapController (GET /bootstrap, POST /bootstrap/step/1-3)
108:  # EXCEPTION: `/admin/bootstrap/select-claim` (POST) is explicitly excluded.
111:  @csrf_bypass_excluded_paths ["/admin/bootstrap/select-claim"]
134:    get "/bootstrap/select-claim", LoginController, :select_claim
135:    post "/bootstrap/select-claim", LoginController, :confirm_claim
138:    # No admin session required — accessible before bootstrap is complete.
139:    # The :bootstrap_gate plug in BootstrapController redirects to /admin/login
140:    # once bootstrap IS complete (the wizard must be locked after first-time setup).
141:    get "/bootstrap", BootstrapController, :index
142:    post "/bootstrap/step/1", BootstrapController, :save_step1
143:    post "/bootstrap/step/2", BootstrapController, :save_step2
144:    post "/bootstrap/step/3", BootstrapController, :save_step3

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== bootstrap_active refs ==="; grep -rn "bootstrap_active\|bootstrap_enabled\|bootstrap_mode" server/lib server/priv 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== admin router bootstrap routes ==="; grep -n "bootstrap" server/lib/nebu/admin/router.ex | head -40
